exposure: Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES)
outcome: Surgical data (e.g., time of port installation, operation time)
cohort: 34 patients with benign diseases at a tertiary center and teaching University hospital.
finding: vNOTES for hysterectomy and adnexal procedures was found to be feasible and generally safe, with a learning curve reaching proficiency by the 10th case.
